description: Finds businesses on BlooTrue from what the person asked for, in their words: what they need and what matters to them, plus the town or city if they named one (for example 'family dentist, gentle with kids, open Saturdays'). Use it when someone wants a business with real reviews, not for their own widgets. Read-only. Returns up to 24 a page with their BlooTrue page link, each review platform's own rating and count, and why they matched.

query.description: What the person is looking for, in their words. Include the town or city only if they named one.

name: find_businesses
title: Find businesses and their reviews
